title: Subscriptions: MRR & Churn
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: MRR
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(s.mrr), 2) FROM dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE s.cancel_date IS NULL

kpis.label: Active subscribers
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE s.cancel_date IS NULL

kpis.label: Churn last month %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE date_trunc('month', s.cancel_date) = DATE '2026-09-01') / (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE s.start_date < DATE '2026-09-01' AND (s.cancel_date IS NULL OR s.cancel_date >= DATE '2026-09-01')), 2)

kpis.label: Expansion MRR, last 12 months
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(ch.mrr_delta), 2) FROM dash_demo.subscription_changes ch JOIN dash_demo.subscriptions s USING (subscription_id) WHERE ch.change_type = 'expansion' AND ch.change_date > DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 12 MONTH

kpis.label: MRR
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(s.mrr), 2) FROM dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE s.cancel_date IS NULL AND s.plan IN ('Pro')

kpis.label: Active subscribers
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE s.cancel_date IS NULL AND s.plan IN ('Pro')

kpis.label: Churn last month %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE date_trunc('month', s.cancel_date) = DATE '2026-09-01' AND s.plan IN ('Pro')) / (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE s.start_date < DATE '2026-09-01' AND (s.cancel_date IS NULL OR s.cancel_date >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND s.plan IN ('Pro')), 2)

kpis.label: Expansion MRR, last 12 months
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(ch.mrr_delta), 2) FROM dash_demo.subscription_changes ch JOIN dash_demo.subscriptions s USING (subscription_id) WHERE ch.change_type = 'expansion' AND ch.change_date > DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 12 MONTH AND s.plan IN ('Pro')

density.bucket: month x plan, subscriptions active in the month
density.rule: each series of a split area chart
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT m, s.plan, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT unnest(generate_series(DATE '2025-10-01', DATE '2026-09-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH))::DATE AS m) months, dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE true AND s.start_date <= m AND (s.cancel_date IS NULL OR s.cancel_date > m) GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.subscriptions s WHERE true AND s.start_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', s.start_date))
